meta.title: Request Best Offer from selected vendors only
gaps: Whether the selected vendors receive the notification.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Whether the selected vendors receive the notification.

plan.title: Request Best Offer to Selected Vendors

steps.note: Open an existing RFQ event with vendor quotes for the buyer-side request workflow.
Confirm the RFQ stage currently offers the Request Best Offers action.
Open the Best Offer request interface from the RFQ Settings menu.

args.goal: Set a duration, choose specific vendors rather than all vendors, send the Best Offer request, and stop on the request results showing that only the selected vendors have the Best Offer Requested status.

steps.note: Perform the vendor selection and submission flow that no dedicated catalog step can express, while verifying the selected-only outcome on screen.
Confirm the completed request screen has no application error.
